name: Two-Pass Ray Entry/Exit Determination
aliases: Two-Pass Raycasting with Back-Face Depth Buffering
definition: Method to determine 3D texture coordinates for ray entry and exit points by rendering the bounding volume faces with colors equal to their texture coordinates.
summary: Two-Pass Ray Entry/Exit Determination uses GPU rasterization of a bounding box with face culling to find ray intersections, avoiding procedural calculations.
